decisions.reason: As a closely related accessory, it fits the firm's existing machine, tooling, and application know-how, so the firm can learn from customer use and improve it with relatively low risk.

Because hybrid additive post-processing is comparatively distant from the firm's core knowledge base, the firm has weaker absorptive capacity here and is more likely to reallocate resources to products it can develop and support more effectively.

A high-speed CNC milling machine is central to the firm's established competencies, and its R&D, modular engineering, service network, and customer base make continued commercialization and refinement highly feasible.

The automatic tool change system builds directly on the firm's installed base and process expertise, giving it strong scope to assimilate user feedback and enhance customer productivity within its core business.
